compilerOptions.//target: ES2020, not ES2017, since LP.16d: src/lib/money.ts is scaled-bigint arithmetic and a BigInt LITERAL is a syntax error below ES2020. `noEmit` is on and `lib` is already esnext, so this changes nothing that is emitted or type-visible — only whether tsc accepts the literal. BigInt has been in every browser this console supports since 2020.
compilerOptions.//allowImportingTsExtensions: Node's native type stripping requires the extension on a relative import, and the workspace packages already re-export that way (packages/auth/src/index.ts and friends). Safe here because noEmit is on — TypeScript only rejects .ts specifiers when it would have to rewrite them into an emitted file.
